# Devin Frank Live - For LLMs

## Brand Overview
- **Name**: Devin Frank Live
- **Domain**: https://devinfranklive.com
- **Primary Role**: Working musician - solo live performances on piano and acoustic guitar
- **Secondary Role**: Content creator - documenting real-world live performance, gear, and music business insights
- **Parent Company**: Frank Creations LLC
- **Instruments**: Piano and acoustic guitar (not simultaneously)
- **Contact**: mockingbirddevin@gmail.com

## Content Focus Areas

### 1. Live Performance & Booking
- Solo piano and acoustic guitar performances
- Restaurants & Wineries
- Weddings & Special Events
- Churches & Faith-Based Events
- Festivals & Community Events
- Private Events
- Corporate & Nonprofit Gatherings
- Geographic focus: Northwest Ohio, nearby Southeast Michigan

### 2. Field Notes (Live Performance Articles)
- Practical, experience-based articles about solo performance
- Real-world insights on: reading rooms, managing volume, selecting equipment, adapting to venues
- Honest documentation of what works in actual gigs
- Categories: Live Performance, Gear Reviews, Gig Tips, Sound & Production, Music Business, Church Music, Restaurant Gigs

### 3. Gear Directory
- Detailed documentation of equipment in actual use
- Focus: portable, reliable gear suitable for solo performers
- Current equipment: Studiologic Numa X Piano 73, Allen & Heath CQ-20B mixer, EV Evolve speakers, Taylor guitar, plus software/controllers
- Honest assessment of pros/cons and real-world use cases
- Not a comprehensive gear database—focused on equipment Devin actively uses and knows well

### 4. Music Business & Solo Artist Topics
- Practical guide to being a full-time solo musician
- Real lessons from working gigs
- Sound reinforcement and mixing for intimate venues
- Workflow optimization for solo setup/teardown
- Personal experience-based, not theory-based

## Brand Attributes
- **Voice**: Honest, practical, experienced-based
- **No fake expertise** - only documents real use and testing
- **Editorial Independence** - no sponsored content without clear labeling
- **Affiliate Disclosure** - future affiliate links will be clearly marked if used
- **Working musician focus** - content serves actual working musicians, not only hobbyists

## Repertoire & Performance Style
- Piano and acoustic guitar across 50s–2000s+ music
- Pop, rock, country, soul, folk, ballads, sing-alongs
- Classics and contemporary favorites
- Church/worship-appropriate selections
- Volume and energy adapted to event type
- Professional sound equipment included
- Compact, flexible setup (one person, one instrument, professional audio)

Notable songs: Piano Man, Imagine, Hey Jude, Fast Car, Hotel California, Country Roads, Wagon Wheel, Hang On Sloopy, Don't Stop Believin', and 22+ others.

## What to Know
- Devin performs on one instrument per song, not both simultaneously
- Solo performer; no band or backup musicians
- Professional background music or featured performance—both available
- Special songs can be learned in advance when arranged ahead
- No DJ services; live performance only
- Does not invent or exaggerate credentials, testimonials, or booking stats

## Website Structure
- 10 public pages (Home, About, Book, Restaurants & Wineries, Weddings, Churches, Festivals, Song List, Shows, Contact)
- Fully static HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Responsive mobile-first design
- Accessibility-focused (WCAG AA)
- Fast performance (no heavy dependencies)
